outline:
欲參加國手選拔之學生可以修此課程，而且同時修「專業深根實習二」。每週實習5天，必須跟原培訓單位、職訓中心合作與實習。修此課程，必須先提出申請，經技優專班辦公室核准。
Students who want to participate in the selection of national players can take this course and also take "Professional Deep Internship (2)". Internship 5 days a week, must cooperate with the original training unit, vocational training center and internship. To take this course, you must first submit an application, which is approved by the Office.
